plugin.note: Ranged is recommended; wear full Shayzien tier 5 and carry poison protection. Only the northern settlement caves require a lizardman task; the canyon and Molch temple also allow off-task kills.

requirements: Full Shayzien tier 5 negates acid-spit damage but does not prevent poison.
A Slayer helmet can replace only the Shayzien helm after the hard Kourend & Kebos Diary AND speaking to Captain Cleive to unlock its protection.
The Wiki recommends 60+ Ranged and 40+ Prayer (43+ preferred), or 80+ Attack and Strength for melee. These are recommendations rather than universal entry gates.
mechanics: Ranged allows easier movement; shamans have no ranged defence bonus and negative stab defence. Slash, crush and magic face higher defence.
Canyon shamans are multi-combat and cannonable. Northern settlement caves and the Molch temple are single-combat and do not permit a cannon.

methods.summary: A ranged setup with all five acid-protection slots enforced.
steps: Keep every required Shayzien piece equipped; use the tier 5 helmet until the diary and Captain Cleive unlock are both complete.
Use ranged and keep space from the shaman.
Move away from jumps and exploding spawns. The western or southern wall can block jump landing positions; wall positioning does not neutralise every special.
risks: Poison remains possible while wearing the full protective set.

Carry every cannon component and sufficient steel cannonballs; the settlement caves and temple do not allow this method.

risks: The extra reach does not bypass acid protection or exploding-spawn movement.

methods.label: Three locations and task access
methods.summary: Choose the room type and assignment restriction before preparing a trip.
steps: The western Lizardman Canyon holds three shamans in multi-combat and allows a cannon.
The caves north of the Lizardman Settlement contain eight shamans, two in each of four single-combat rooms. A lizardman Slayer assignment is required.

The temple beneath Molch has six shamans, two in each of three single-combat rooms, and permits off-task kills. Enter through a dwelling; the strange hole is the exit. Repeated internal barrier crossings cause increasing damage after three and six crossings.
Travel from Xeric's Inferno or fairy ring DJR to the canyon and settlement; Xeric's Lookout is an alternative approach to Molch.

advisor.coverageStatus: Current raw Wiki supporting strategy reviewed; static reference

methods.label: Acid protection and exact helmet waiver
methods.summary: The diary reward only replaces the helmet slot and must be explicitly activated.
steps: Acid spit otherwise deals up to 30 unblockable damage and can poison. Full tier 5 Shayzien armour negates the damage while still allowing poison.
Complete the hard Kourend & Kebos Diary, then actively speak to Captain Cleive to activate Slayer helmet protection. Completing the diary alone does not enable it.
Keep Shayzien body, greaves, gloves and boots tier 5 equipped even after unlocking the Slayer helmet option. Other armour in those slots removes full protection.

methods.label: Jump and exploding-spawn avoidance
methods.summary: Walls influence jump landing availability but exploding spawns still require movement.
steps: A jump targets the previous player position. Its impact covers 3-by-3 tiles in the canyon and 2-by-2 in the temple, with the northeast temple tile at the target.
Blocking the landing tile to the south or west with a wall prevents jumps. Canyon obstacles and the temple western or southern walls provide useful positions.
Three spawns appear: two nearby and one underneath. The one underneath explodes first; their 8-10 damage reaches players within two tiles. Move away or use obstacles to interfere with their path.

methods.label: Range and wall positioning alternatives
methods.summary: Weapons with more than eight tiles of range can outrange standard attacks.
steps: Shamans have an attack range of eight. Longbows, composite bows, crystal bow and Bow of Faerdhinen can outrange this on rapid.
Shortbows, crossbows and Karil's crossbow can reach farther on longrange at the cost of attack speed.
Use this together with terrain and spawn awareness. The Wiki describes range and landing restrictions, not a universal stationary safespot immune to all specials.

methods.label: Canyon, cave and temple supplies
methods.summary: Match poison and prayer supplies to room choice and intended trip length.
steps: Canyon ranged: two divine ranging potions, one antidote++ or two superantipoisons, optional one or two stamina potions, six to eight prayer potions, cannon and cannonballs, food and an emergency teleport.

Settlement caves: similar ranged supplies without a cannon, with an optional stamina potion. Temple: three or four ranging potions, two antidote++ or three or four superantipoisons, mostly prayer supplies and some food.
Melee: one or two super combat potions, one or two poison remedies, three or four prayer potions (six to eight when using Piety), food and an optional special weapon.

Optional High Level Alchemy and Bones to Peaches require the corresponding unlock, spellbook and nature/fire/water/earth runes; a Bones to peaches tablet is the alternative. A holy wrench and herb sack are optional trip extensions.
